input.prompt: Dramatic YouTube thumbnail image, stylized 3D CGI render in the same simulation style as the reference image (clean 3D, saturated colors), 16:9. Scene: an offshore rocket launch platform on the equator at the exact moment Earth spins so fast that gravity disappears. IMPORTANT: keep the whole upper-left third of the image as plain sky with no objects, so a text can be placed there. No text, no letters, no watermark. Low angle looking up: the sky is filled with floating people, containers, water droplets and fish, all rising toward a huge dark cloud vortex. Below, the ocean surface bulges upward into a giant dome of water around the platform. A worker in the foreground is desperately gripping the yellow railing with both hands while his body floats horizontally, terrified face. Warm orange rim light, deep blue shadows, maximum drama.
